text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I go to see the<n>Satsuki Sho
together, and she keeps<n>her eyes silently glued to
Narita Brian<n>the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though Narita Brian wins the race<n>with a record
breaking time, Biwa<n>Hayahide boldly declares that
she will<n>beat her sister.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, I get word that the venue<n>for the spring
Tenno Sho is being<n>changed to the Hanshin
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Despite this, Biwa Hayahide is<n>unfazed by the
prospect of having to<n>rebuild our strategy. That's
when I<n>realize how much she's grown.
